firearmScenarioSection.title: Firearm Activities
firearmScenarioSection.description: Select the activities the person is aware that you do, or activities they have joined you on.

scenarios.label: Hunting
scenarios.template: I {{knowledgePhrase}} {{applicantFirstName}} {{showGoes}} on hunting trips {{showAtLeast}} {{frequency}} {{frequencyPeriod}} and have personally seen {{applicantObjectPronoun}} handle firearms in a safe and responsible manner, and care for the animals.

scenarios.label: Sport shooting
scenarios.template: I {{knowledgePhrase}} {{applicantFirstName}} {{takesPartInTo}} sport shooting activities {{showAtLeast}} {{frequency}} {{frequencyPeriod}} and when I have seen {{applicantObjectPronoun}} operate firearms, it is always safely and responsibly.

scenarios.label: Farm or property pest control
scenarios.template: I {{knowledgePhrase}} {{applicantFirstName}} {{showPerformsTo}} lawful culling and pest control activities using firearms {{showAtLeast}} {{frequency}} {{frequencyPeriod}}, and I have seen that this is done with proper handling of firearms and care for the animals.

scenarios.label: Firearm training courses
scenarios.template: I {{knowledgePhrase}} {{applicantFirstName}} {{showAttendsTo}} firearm training {{showAtLeast}} {{frequency}} {{frequencyPeriod}} and have observed a strong focus on safety and responsible firearm handling.

scenarios.label: Shooting range
scenarios.template: I {{knowledgePhrase}} {{applicantFirstName}} {{showOn}} visits {{showTo}} the shooting range {{showAtLeast}} {{frequency}} {{frequencyPeriod}} and when I have seen {{applicantObjectPronoun}} operate firearms, it is always safely and responsibly.

scenarios.label: Shooting competitions
scenarios.template: I {{knowledgePhrase}} {{applicantFirstName}} take part in shooting competitions {{showAtLeast}} {{frequency}} {{frequencyPeriod}} and when I have seen {{applicantObjectPronoun}} handle firearms, {{applicantSubjectPronoun}} does so safely and responsibly.

scenarios.label: Recreational target practice
scenarios.template: I {{knowledgePhrase}} {{applicantFirstName}} does recreational target practice {{showAtLeast}} {{frequency}} {{frequencyPeriod}} and have seen safe, controlled and responsible firearm use.
